If you can manage that, go south. After that, make an effort to go to the south. If you can get around to doing that, try to take a trip south. Once you succeed at that, go to the west. After that, make an attempt to travel north. Next, head east. After that, head south. And then, travel east. Once you accomplish that, go to the east. Then, make an attempt to travel north. Then, attempt to head north. Okay, and then, travel west. Next, go west. Then, attempt to take a trip north. With that over with, go east. And then, head south. Once you accomplish that, try to take a trip south. And then, pick up the coin from the floor of the balmy canteen. And once you've done that, you win!
